name: Bitticks Agents
description: 100 unique AI trading agents inscribed on Bitcoin. Each Bitticks Agent grants its holder access to the Bittick autonomous trading platform — AI bots that analyze and trade BTC on your behalf. The collection includes 10 rare Founders (palindrome inscriptions, orange background), 5 God agents, 5 Throne agents, and 80 standard Agents. Owning a Bitticks Agent means owning a piece of Bitcoin history and a functional AI trading tool on the most secure blockchain in the world.
